scenes.title: UE5 Actor and Pawn
lines: What happens to the character you see on screen? In Unreal Engine 5, Actor is the base class for a game object you can place in a level. A Pawn is an Actor that a player or AI can control. A Character is a kind of Pawn that can walk and jump. A car can be a Pawn as well. A Controller directs the Pawn. When the player gets into a car, the same Controller can switch from the character Pawn to the vehicle Pawn.

scenes.title: Effect of the Tokyo announcement
lines: The Tokyo announcement named Actors and the existing gameplay framework as part of the transition. Pawn inherits from Actor, so character and vehicle control code built on that hierarchy is affected too. The keynote report does not name a one-to-one replacement class for Pawn. Epic’s proposed direction is to attach components to entities and write behavior in Verse.
